label: anti_partisan_operation
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list in chronological order the named anti-partisan operations (with code names) that his division carried out after he was appointed its commander.
why_needs_multiple: Liệt kê các chiến dịch chống du kích có tên mã sau khi được bổ nhiệm chỉ huy sư đoàn, cần ít nhất ba mốc cùng label anti_partisan_operation.
criterion: Named anti-partisan operations (with code names) carried out by his division after his appointment as its commander. Unnamed attacks, such as the 24 May attack on a strongpoint, are not named operations.
window_from: after his appointment as commander of the 8th SS Cavalry Division Florian Geyer

flagged_nearby_ids.reason: combat của sư đoàn ngày 17 tháng 5 (derived_date, cách e48 mười ngày), không phải chiến dịch có tên nên không cùng loại với tiêu chí; không ảnh hưởng danh sách.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the occasions before the 1940s on which he joined or was transferred into a military, police, party or SS organization.
why_needs_multiple: Tóm tắt các lần gia nhập hoặc chuyển vào tổ chức trong giai đoạn trước những năm 1940, cần ít nhất ba mốc.
criterion: Occasions on which he joined an organization or was transferred into one (military regiment, police, Nazi Party and SA, SS). Leaving an organization is not included, so the end of the police service is excluded.

question: By calendar year, how many years separate his appointment as commander of the SS Main Riding School in Munich from his appointment as commander of the 8th SS Cavalry Division Florian Geyer?
why_needs_multiple: Câu hỏi khoảng cách cần đúng hai mốc bổ nhiệm được nêu tên bằng lời.
